open import AgdaDojang.Debug

open import Data.List.Base using ( List ; _++_ ; map )

open import Data.List.Properties using ( ++-assoc )

map-++-diag : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (xs : List ℕ) → map f (xs ++ xs) ≡ map f xs ++ map f xs
map-++-diag f xs = {!!}
